architectureDecisions: D1 — Introduce PROJECT_SEED_V1 as the only product-entry envelope for this slice. seedKind is exactly GOAL_ONLY | REQUIREMENTS_DESIGN | EXISTING_CODE; the seed binds project/root identity, immutable supplied artifact refs, declared acceptance refs and explicit missing authoritative decision kinds. Seed normalization may classify missing inputs but cannot invent product decisions.

D2 — Introduce PRODUCT_DECISION_REQUEST_V1 for bounded clarification. A request names the unresolved product decision, affected acceptance refs and blocking obligations; only an explicitly configured product-owner authority may resolve it. PM/SA coordination may surface evidence or prerequisites but cannot answer the decision or authorize completion.

D3 — Implement product delivery as a thin application composition over existing OrganizationWorkContract, cross-domain obligation/currentness, domain activation and domain execution/publication boundaries. The composition materializes explicit domain obligations from the seed/accepted decisions; it never selects another domain's runtime or implements a central next-role/workflow scheduler.

D4 — Role semantics are fixed for v1: PM owns product-decision/acceptance intent, BA owns requirement obligations, SA owns architecture assessment, FE/BE own domain implementation, DevOps owns deployable release evidence, and QA owns independent product verification. These are semantic obligation owners, not a generic role registry or agent-routing DSL.

D5 — Parallelism is dependency-derived only. FE and BE may claim independently when their exact direct semantic prerequisites are current; cross-domain publication emits typed obligations and lineage, and no coordinator serializes them merely because they belong to one product.

D6 — Product outcome closure is fail-closed. BB-070 may request closure only when the delivered BB-055 product-state/completeness boundary reports current deployment, QA and completeness evidence for the exact release. Runtime success, domain ACCEPT or a Playwright pass alone cannot close the product outcome.

D7 — Playwright v1.63.0 is selected only as the browser-observation adapter for the live product probe and trace/artifact capture. Browser evidence is bound to exact release/deployment identity and remains input to independent acceptance; Playwright has no lifecycle, work-selection or publication authority.

D8 — LangGraph v1.2.12 is rejected for BB-070 runtime orchestration: its checkpoint/interrupt graph machinery would add a second coordinator over already-delivered application/domain authority. OpenHands software-agent-sdk v1.49.6 remains the upstream coding-runtime seam owned by BB-066/BB-069 and is consumed only through their delivered outputs, not embedded into the BB-070 lifecycle controller.

D9 — Worker preflight must re-resolve BB-055 and BB-069 as DONE and bind their exact consolidated/delivery outputs. If delivered closure or live-runtime seams differ from the assumptions in this plan, execution stops with PLAN_INPUT_CONTRADICTION and returns to RESEARCH_SA rather than adapting architecture inside Worker.

expectedDependencyOutputs: BB-055 DONE: exact product completeness/currentness and ProductStateProjection/ProductOutcomeClaim closure seam; Worker must bind the delivered names/refs rather than assuming the draft shape.
BB-069 DONE: exact supported live coding-agent delivery/runtime seam and reference web-product fixture/release identity used by the BB-070 live probe.

implementationSlices: S0 — Dependency contract preflight: require BB-055 and BB-069 DONE, load their exact consolidated/delivery refs and reject incompatible closure/runtime/reference-product seams as PLAN_INPUT_CONTRADICTION.

S1 — Seed/clarification contract: implement PROJECT_SEED_V1 normalization for the three seed kinds plus PRODUCT_DECISION_REQUEST_V1; prove missing authoritative decisions block without invented defaults and resolved decisions are identity-bound.

S2 — Domain-owned lifecycle composition: map normalized seed + accepted decisions into explicit BA/SA/FE/BE/DevOps/QA obligations using existing organization materialization and semantic obligation contracts; preserve dependency-derived FE/BE concurrency and forbid central next-role selection.

S3 — Product closure composition: consume exact delivered BB-055 closure semantics and allow closure request only for the exact current release when deployment, independent QA and completeness evidence are current.

S4 — Deterministic boundary suite: run all three seed fixtures; assert equivalent declared acceptance semantics, bounded clarification, domain ownership, independent parallel claims, stale/missing evidence rejection and producer-success-with-failing-acceptance negatives.

S5 — Execute preregistered BB070_SEED_EQUIVALENCE_V1: three independently reset live arms (GOAL_ONLY, REQUIREMENTS_DESIGN, EXISTING_CODE) over the exact BB-069 reference product with one frozen acceptanceSemanticDigest/runtime/budget profile. Persist the complete per-arm identity/evidence matrix, audit it separately, and reject any NOT_RUN/stale/missing/QA-failed arm; deterministic fixtures cannot satisfy this slice.
S6 — Update Living truth with only the implemented seed/lifecycle/closure capability, explicit limits and the fact that outer Blackboard remains separate from product runtime coordination.
